dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute tip with a small rounding radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep convex curve rising from the dorsal midline at an approximate 55-degree angle relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Height is approximately equal to the base width, maintaining a near 1:1 ratio.

anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt beak extension where the horizontal length is approximately 1.5 times the vertical thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse interior angle measured at the pixel coordinate where the descending melon slope meets the horizontal rostrum plane.
